presentationTable.name: Product AI Cluster Labels

presentationColumns.name: Cluster ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Cluster ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden technical identifier for a behavior cluster produced by the product AI model.

presentationColumns.name: Cluster Label
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Cluster Label
presentationColumns.description: Business-facing name for a group of similar product behavior cases.

presentationColumns.name: Business Interpretation
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Business Interpretation
presentationColumns.description: Plain-language explanation of what the cluster generally means for merchants, planners, or store teams.

presentationColumns.name: Recommended Action
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Recommended Action
presentationColumns.description: Suggested business response for cases belonging to this behavior cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Evidence Summary
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Evidence Summary
presentationColumns.description: Summary of the common measured behaviors behind the cluster, such as demand, markdown, returns, or risk.

presentationColumns.name: Action Priority
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Action Priority
presentationColumns.description: Priority score assigned to the cluster label and recommended action.

presentationColumns.name: Product Week Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Product Week Count
presentationColumns.description: Number of AI signal cases represented by the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: SKU Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.SKU Count
presentationColumns.description: Number of distinct SKUs represented in the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Store Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Store Count
presentationColumns.description: Number of stores represented in the cluster. This matters because Product AI is now store-aware.

presentationColumns.name: Style Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Style Count
presentationColumns.description: Number of distinct styles represented in the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Average Full Price Unit Share Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Average Full Price Unit Share Percent
presentationColumns.description: Average full-price unit share among AI signal cases in the cluster. Use it to judge whether the cluster reflects healthy full-price demand or markdown-driven movement.

presentationColumns.name: Average Lost Sales Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Average Estimated Lost Sales Units
presentationColumns.description: Average estimated lost-sales units among AI signal cases in the cluster. Higher values indicate clusters where missed demand is a common behavior.

presentationColumns.name: Average Lost Sales Rate Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Average Estimated Lost Sales Rate Percent
presentationColumns.description: Average percentage of estimated demand that became estimated lost sales among AI signal cases in the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Average Inbound Supply Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Average Inbound Supply Units
presentationColumns.description: Average replenishment plus transfer-in units among AI signal cases in the cluster. Use it to see whether supply actions are typical for the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Average Cluster Probability
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Average Cluster Probability
presentationColumns.description: Average model confidence for cases assigned to the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Average Units Sold
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Average Fulfilled Units Sold
presentationColumns.description: Average fulfilled units sold among AI signal cases in the cluster; use it as cluster context, not as the primary enterprise Units Sold KPI.

presentationColumns.name: Average Net Sales Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Average Net Sales Amount
presentationColumns.description: Average net sales among AI signal cases in the cluster; use it as cluster context, not as the primary revenue KPI.

presentationColumns.name: Average Full Price Sell Through Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Average Full Price Sell Through Percent
presentationColumns.description: Average full-price sell-through among AI signal cases in the cluster, useful for understanding whether demand is profitable and supply-constrained.

presentationColumns.name: Average Markdown Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Average Markdown Percent
presentationColumns.description: Average markdown percent for the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Average Return Rate Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Average Return Rate Percent
presentationColumns.description: Average return rate percent for the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Cluster Avg Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Cluster Avg Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Average stockout risk among AI signal cases in the cluster. It describes the cluster profile rather than the latest state of one SKU or store.

presentationColumns.name: Cluster Avg Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Cluster Avg Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Average overstock risk among AI signal cases in the cluster. It describes the cluster profile rather than the latest state of one SKU or store.

presentationColumns.name: Average Anomaly Probability
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Average Anomaly Probability
presentationColumns.description: Average anomaly probability for product-week cases in the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Anomaly Row Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Anomaly Row Count
presentationColumns.description: Number of anomalous product-week cases represented in the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Modal Department
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Modal Department
presentationColumns.description: Most common department among the AI signal cases assigned to the cluster. It describes the dominant cluster profile, not every case in the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Modal Category
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Modal Category
presentationColumns.description: Most common category among the AI signal cases assigned to the cluster. It describes the dominant cluster profile, not every case in the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Modal Region
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Modal Region
presentationColumns.description: Most common store region among AI signal cases assigned to the cluster. It describes the dominant cluster profile, not every case in the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Modal Price Tier
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Modal Price Tier
presentationColumns.description: Most common price tier among the AI signal cases assigned to the cluster. It describes the dominant cluster profile, not every case in the cluster.

presentationColumns.name: Modal Reason Code
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product AI Cluster Labels.Modal Reason Code
presentationColumns.description: Most common reason code among the AI signal cases assigned to the cluster. Use it as a quick cluster explanation, not as the reason for every individual case.

presentationTable.description: Notebook-derived cluster labels and explanations for Product AI signal cases. Use this to understand behavior patterns and common recommended actions.
